comparison.objective: Retrieve a rear spice jar and restore the obstructing bottle, versus commission a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Title implies occlusion-aware sequencing, temporary relocation, retrieval, and restoration; detailed manipulation rubric is absent. Candidate requires tool alignment and fine mechanical tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Only the title specifies retrieving the jar and replacing the moved bottle; pose tolerances and scoring are missing. Candidate requires two measured safe stops and retained locking.
comparison.reason: Rearrangement with restoration tests planning and object placement, not dynamic mechanism adjustment.
